Project: Rewrite is a VR experience that turns historical images and imagined alternate histories into explorable 3D worlds.
Scene: an open antique history book on the right becomes a miniature architectural portal into a sunlit historic stone courtyard. An elegant small VR headset rests just in front of the book, connecting history with immersion. The portal, pages and architecture form ONE coherent sculptural vignette, not a collage or a diagram.
Style: premium soft 3D illustration with tactile parchment, weathered sandstone, polished bronze and subtle warm volumetric light. Background is warm ivory with a faint parchment wash; restrained sepia, antique gold and dusty teal accents. It should feel wondrous, scholarly and cinematic, never a generic neon metaverse.
Text (verbatim): "Rewrite" in a very large dark warm-brown elegant editorial serif on the left, inspired by antique book typography but extremely legible. No subtitle.
